page_title: FUL 0-1 MNU | Fulham v Manchester Utd 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' It's like he was asking for a caution. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a yellow card.
90+7' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alejandro Garnacho departs the field of play to be replaced by Raphael Varane (Manchester United).
90+1' 0 - 1 Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Harry Wilson is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Tom Cairney (Fulham).
89' Substitution. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) on for Alex Iwobi.
89' Fulham have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
88' The game has begun to heat up. Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
85' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sees a yellow card from John Brooks after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
84' A cross into the box picks out Anthony Martial (Manchester United), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
84' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Bernd Leno has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
83' It seemed like Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
82' A yellow-coloured card is received by Alex Iwobi (Fulham).
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andreas Pereira will be replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham).
81' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
79' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mason Mount (Manchester United) replacing Christian Eriksen.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Martial (Manchester United) replaces Rasmus Hojlund.
79' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
78' Manchester Utd work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
77' Harry Wilson (Fulham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
76' Substitution. Willian leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
76' Marco Silva is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Rodrigo Muniz suffers an injury and Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) comes on.
74' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
73' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
72' Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Bernd Leno.
71' John Brooks blows his whistle after Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
68' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' The game is interrupted. Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
66' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
65' Andreas Pereira sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham), whose close-range header flashes just over the bar.
65' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the corner kick.
63' Substitution. Antony will be replaced by Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United).
63' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
62' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) blows a big chance to score after blasting the ball under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. Fulham win a corner.
61' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
61' Harry Wilson (Fulham) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Andre Onana has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
59' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
59' Willian (Fulham) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
58' Willian (Fulham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
57' Willian (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
56' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) was too forceful with his tackle and John Brooks interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
55' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
52' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
52' Manchester Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

51' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the roof of the net, but Bernd Leno pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
51' Harry Wilson (Fulham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
50' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
48' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Bernd Leno stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
48' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
46' John Brooks blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) sends a wild header high over the bar.
45+3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45+3' Willian (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Fulham earn a corner.
45+2' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45+2' John Brooks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).
45+1' Willian (Fulham) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) inside the box. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
44' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
44' A pass into the penalty area from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
41' The resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared by the defence.

40' Rasmus Hojlund receives a sweet cross inside the box from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
39' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post.

37' Antony (Manchester United) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul.
34' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Bernd Leno stops the ball from going inside right post.
33' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
32' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
31' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Antonee Robinson (Fulham) for his blatant foul.
31' Manchester Utd play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
28' An attempted cross from Tim Ream (Fulham) is cleared.
27' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
27' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
26' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
24' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
23' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

23' Willian (Fulham) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) makes a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
20' A short through ball almost allows Scott McTominay (Manchester United) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
18' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
16' Flag goes up against Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Willian (Fulham) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
14' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
12' Celebrations are cut short for Manchester Utd as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
9' Wait! Referee John Brooks has indicated he is going to review the Manchester Utd goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

8' Goal! Scott McTominay (Manchester United) takes a short pass from Alejandro Garnacho in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.

8' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Manchester Utd, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
6' John Brooks blows his whistle and it's Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
5' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
4' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
2' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be John Brooks.
